reuse.why: All month-wide actions, including setLastMonthSpending, use the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and averageToBudget, and the #fixed check reuses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser.

duplication.why: Each exclusion is added once in the shared selection; the shared BulkBudgetArgs type removes repeated argument types.

placement.why: Exclusions live in the bulk-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, the layer that already decides which categories bulk actions write.

scope.why: Focused on the bulk actions and handler, but includes an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts and a -0 tweak to averageToBudget.

maintainability.why: Single owner for the category selection with clear docs; the template rule is split as a json_each SQL subquery while the other rules are JS filters.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every bulk action passes includeHiddenCategories into getBulkBudgetCategories; no action filters categories itself.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories' existing includeHidden parameter is renamed to includeHiddenCategories; the template and #fixed rules apply uniformly to all callers.
